title: An idea, made clear
subtitle: A visual note for curious learners

intro.vo: Start with one clear idea. Give your viewer a familiar example, show the relationship, then leave them with a small thing to try.

scenes.title: From idea to example

steps.title: Idea
steps.text: State the point in plain words.

steps.title: Practice
steps.text: Give the viewer one thing to try.

scenes.after: One scene should carry one useful thought.
scenes.vo: An explanation can move from the idea to an example and then to practice. Choose the sequence that fits the subject and the learner.

scenes.title: Leave room to think

widget.text: A short message can still explain a real idea.
widget.detail: Use the picture to support the words.

scenes.vo: Keep the screen calm. Use simple outlines, readable type and empty space around the main point. Let the example do some of the explaining.

outro.line3: Replace this sample with your brief.
outro.vo: Choose your next subject, decide who it is for, and replace this sample with an explanation of your own.
